Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Daiar Grelin: 30-year-old woman, 179 cm (tall), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: wide triangular face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: high gathered coil mass. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette oxblood-navy. Visible personal details: a shaped cloth clasp. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
